title: List components
description: List components filtered by role and property, ordered by name, GMO ID, or the number of media whose recipes directly include each component.

role_id.description: GMO ID of a role directly assigned to the component. Leave empty to apply no role filter.

property_id.description: GMO ID of a property directly assigned to the component. The property must be a direct subclass of Component property. Leave empty to apply no property filter.

sort.description: Sort key: name for the preferred label, id for the GMO ID, or medium_count for the number of media whose recipes directly include the component.

order.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return. Use a non-negative safe integer; 0 returns an empty list.

offset.description: Number of components to skip. Use a non-negative safe integer.
